task: The Tokenizer disagrees with browsers about where some constructs end, so markup that a browser treats as live can be hidden from a sanitizer built on this parser, and the other way round. Fix all of these. Callback numbers below are exact character offsets. Comments must also close on --!>. Today, --> is one long comment. It must tokenize as: oncomment(4, 8, 3), then the img open tag and its attributes (onopentagname(10, 13), onattribname(14, 17), onattribdata(18, 19), onattribend(1, 19), onattribname(20, 27), onattribdata(28, 36), onattribend(1, 36), onopentagend(36)), then ontext(37, 40) and onend. The third oncomment argument is the terminator length minus one: 3 for --!>, and 2 for --> as today. A comment still closes on -->, and --! followed by anything else does not close it. End tags that end with /> must close script, style, title and textarea. Today, in , the end tag is not recognized, so the img is swallowed as script text. Expected tokenizer output: onopentagname(1, 7), onopentagend(7), ontext(8, 12), onclosetag(14, 20), onopentagname(23, 26), onopentagend(26), onend. The other three follow the same pattern: gives onclosetag(13, 18) and onopentagname(21, 24), safe gives onclosetag(13, 18) and onopentagname(21, 24), and gives onclosetag(16, 24) and onopentagname(27, 30). At Parser level, the script case gives closetag with startIndex 12 and endIndex 20, and then img events with startIndex 21 and endIndex 26.
